name: Pizza Time
author: monstropato
description: PEPPER RONI!!! You late, man, AWAYS late! And those maledetto ducks stole the pizza AGAIN! Climb up the mountain and take the pizza back NOW! ADESSO! Or this time you gonna be F-I-R-E-D! If you get late because of that old car of yours, AGAIN, it will be discounted in you paycheck, AGAIN! Ora vai! VAI!
